keyEvents.text: Second Half begins Lincoln City 0, Wrexham 0.
Daniel Oyegoke (Lincoln City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Lincoln City. Reeco Hackett replaces Ethan Wheatley.
Substitution, Wrexham. Jacques Ekomié replaces Oliver Rathbone.
Substitution, Lincoln City. Dom Jefferies replaces Callum Elder.
Substitution, Wrexham. Bailey Cadamarteri replaces Lewis O'Brien.
Substitution, Wrexham. Danny Imray replaces Issa Kaboré.
Substitution, Wrexham. Ben Sheaf replaces George Dobson.
Goal! Lincoln City 0, Wrexham 1. George Thomason (Wrexham) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, Lincoln City. Chiedozie Ogbene replaces Adam Reach.
Substitution, Lincoln City. Mikkel Ladefoged replaces Rob Street.
Substitution, Lincoln City. Tom Hamer replaces Tom Bayliss.
